themes.label: Oncology drug pipeline innovation
themes.rationale: AZN's growth is heavily driven by its oncology franchise (Tagrisso, Enhertu, Imfinzi, Lynparza); continued pipeline output and label expansions are a major determinant of revenue growth and multiple support.

themes.label: Biopharma patent cliff and generic erosion
themes.rationale: Several AZN blockbusters face patent expiry through the late 2020s/early 2030s; exposure to loss of exclusivity and biosimilar/generic erosion is a recurring risk factor investors track across large pharma.

themes.label: Drug pricing and government reimbursement policy
themes.rationale: AZN's US and EU revenue is directly exposed to reimbursement policy shifts (e.g., US IRA price negotiation, EU pricing reforms), affecting realized pricing on key products.

themes.label: GLP-1 and obesity drug demand
themes.rationale: AZN has an emerging oral GLP-1 candidate and obesity-adjacent pipeline; its economics could be shaped by the broader GLP-1/obesity demand wave that is repricing the metabolic disease category across pharma.
